Age.name: Infant Age
Age.description: The age of the newborn infant since birth.

states_description.0-3_days: Newborn within the first 3 days of life.

BirthAsphyxia.name: Birth Asphyxia
BirthAsphyxia.description: Whether the infant experienced oxygen deprivation during or shortly after birth.

states_description.no: The infant did not experience birth asphyxia.

CO2.name: Blood CO2 Level
CO2.description: The measured carbon dioxide level in the infant's blood.

states_description.Normal: CO2 level is within the normal range.

CO2Report.name: CO2 Report
CO2Report.description: The reported blood CO2 measurement categorized by a clinical threshold.

states_description.<7.5: Reported CO2 value is below 7.5 kPa.
states_description.>=7.5: Reported CO2 value is 7.5 kPa or above.

CardiacMixing.name: Cardiac Mixing
CardiacMixing.description: The degree of mixing between oxygenated and deoxygenated blood within the heart.

states_description.None: No mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood.
states_description.Mild: Mild mixing of blood across cardiac chambers.
states_description.Complete: Complete mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood.
Transposition physiology with parallel circulations requiring mixing for survival.

ChestXray.name: Chest X-ray Finding
ChestXray.description: The actual appearance of the infant's chest X-ray.

states_description.Oligaemic: Lung fields show reduced blood flow (oligaemic appearance).
states_description.Plethoric: Lung fields show increased blood flow (plethoric appearance).
states_description.Grd_Glass: Lung fields show a diffuse ground-glass opacity.
states_description.Asy/Patch: Lung fields show asymmetric or patchy opacities.

Disease.name: Congenital Disease
Disease.description: The underlying congenital heart or lung disease affecting the infant.

states_description.PFC: Persistent Fetal Circulation (persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn).
states_description.PAIVS: Pulmonary Atresia with Intact Ventricular Septum.
states_description.Lung: Primary lung disease without a structural cardiac defect.

DuctFlow.name: Ductus Arteriosus Flow Direction
DuctFlow.description: The direction of blood flow through the ductus arteriosus.

states_description.Lt_to_Rt: Blood flows from left (aorta) to right (pulmonary artery).
states_description.None: No flow through the ductus arteriosus (closed or absent).
states_description.Rt_to_Lt: Blood flows from right (pulmonary artery) to left (aorta).

Grunting.name: Grunting
Grunting.description: Whether the infant is actually exhibiting grunting respirations, a sign of respiratory distress.

GruntingReport.name: Grunting Report
GruntingReport.description: Whether grunting was reported on clinical assessment.

HypDistrib.name: Hypoxia Distribution
HypDistrib.description: Whether hypoxia is distributed equally or unequally between the upper and lower body.

states_description.Equal: Oxygen levels are similar in the upper and lower body.
states_description.Unequal: Oxygen levels differ between the upper and lower body.

HypoxiaInO2.name: Hypoxia in O2
HypoxiaInO2.description: The severity of hypoxia observed when the infant is placed on supplemental oxygen.

states_description.Mild: Mild hypoxia persisting despite supplemental oxygen.
states_description.Moderate: Moderate hypoxia persisting despite supplemental oxygen.
states_description.Severe: Severe hypoxia persisting despite supplemental oxygen.

LVH.name: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy
LVH.description: Whether the infant actually has left ventricular hypertrophy.

states_description.no: Left ventricular hypertrophy is not present.

LVHreport.name: LVH Report
LVHreport.description: Whether left ventricular hypertrophy was reported on clinical evaluation (e.g., ECG or echocardiography).

LowerBodyO2.name: Lower Body Oxygen Saturation
LowerBodyO2.description: The measured oxygen saturation in the infant's lower body (post-ductal).

states_description.<5: Oxygen saturation below 5 kPa, indicating severe hypoxia.
states_description.5-12: Oxygen saturation between 5 and 12 kPa, indicating moderate hypoxia.
states_description.12+: Oxygen saturation above 12 kPa, within or near normal range.

LungFlow.name: Lung Blood Flow
LungFlow.description: The volume of blood flow through the pulmonary vasculature.

LungParench.name: Lung Parenchyma
LungParench.description: The condition of the lung tissue (parenchyma).

states_description.Congested: Lung parenchyma is congested with fluid or blood.
states_description.Abnormal: Lung parenchyma shows abnormal pathology (e.g., disease or inflammation).

RUQO2.name: Right Upper Quadrant Oxygen Saturation
RUQO2.description: The measured oxygen saturation in the right upper quadrant (pre-ductal), typically from the right hand or arm.

states_description.<5: Oxygen saturation below 5 kPa, indicating severe hypoxia.
states_description.5-12: Oxygen saturation between 5 and 12 kPa, indicating moderate hypoxia.
states_description.12+: Oxygen saturation above 12 kPa, within or near normal range.

Sick.name: Sick
Sick.description: Whether the infant appears clinically sick on overall assessment.

states_description.no: The infant does not appear clinically unwell.

XrayReport.name: X-ray Report
XrayReport.description: The radiologist's reported interpretation of the chest X-ray.

states_description.Oligaemic: X-ray reported as showing oligaemic lung fields.
states_description.Plethoric: X-ray reported as showing plethoric lung fields.
states_description.Grd_Glass: X-ray reported as showing ground-glass opacification.
states_description.Asy/Patchy: X-ray reported as showing asymmetric or patchy opacities.
